id: \bEver wonder why we do what we-what is that you have there?!
en: \bEver wonder why we do what we-what is that you have there?!
it: \bTi sei mai chiesto perché facciamo quello che-cos'è quello che hai lì?!

id: \bThat Pikachu you have! Give it to me.
en: \bThat Pikachu you have! Give it to me.

id: \bI need a Pikachu to finish my collection.
en: \bI need a Pikachu to finish my collection.
it: \bMi serve un Pikachu per completare la mia collezione.
\bBah, uno in più non farà male.

id: \bThe thrill of meeting someone. Let's not spoil it with words.
en: \bThe thrill of meeting someone. Let's not spoil it with words.
it: \bL'emozione di conoscere qualcuno. Non roviniamola con le parole.

id: \bA challenger! Perhaps you can help me train.
en: \bA challenger! Perhaps you can help me train.
it: \bUno sfidante! Forse puoi aiutarmi ad allenarmi.

id: \bI saw you coming. Do you know how?
en: \bI saw you coming. Do you know how?

id: \bI just looked behind me, that's all I did...
en: \bI just looked behind me, that's all I did...
it: \bMi sono solo guardato alle spalle, tutto qui...

id: \rYou want to die, kid? You better move on. That Riolu is mine.
en: \rYou want to die, kid? You better move on. That Riolu is mine.
it: \rVuoi morire, ragazzino? Faresti meglio a sparire. Quel Riolu è mio.

id: \rThis is not over. You will give me what I want.
en: \rThis is not over. You will give me what I want.
it: \rNon finisce qui. Mi darai quello che voglio.
